# Spire Hub

> Spire Hub is Bahrain's home for ambitious startups — a coworking and startup hub offering coworking space, private offices, meeting and workshop rooms, mentorship, membership plans, and founder events. Located in Seef, Bahrain.

Spire Hub provides:
- Coworking space and hot desks for founders and startup teams
- Private offices for growing teams, with optional CR address
- Bookable meeting rooms and workshop rooms, billed hourly (VAT included)
- Membership plans for individuals and teams
- Mentorship and incubation support from experienced founders and industry leaders
- Workshops, founder talks, and networking events
- A specialty coffee café open to members and walk-in guests

## Key pages

- [Spire Hub homepage](https://spire.bh/): overview of coworking space, private offices, meeting rooms, membership plans, mentors, and events
- [Coworking Space](https://spire.bh/coworking): hot desks, fixed desks, and day passes in Seef, Bahrain
- [Private Offices](https://spire.bh/private-offices): lockable offices for teams of 1 to 3+, with optional commercial registration address
- [Meeting Rooms](https://spire.bh/meeting-rooms): bookable meeting and workshop rooms with hourly pricing and card payment
- [Mentorship & Incubation](https://spire.bh/mentorship): 1:1 mentor sessions and founder workshops
- [Café](https://spire.bh/cafe): specialty coffee in the Spire Hub workspace
- [Membership](https://spire.bh/#membership): coworking and private office membership plans
- [Events](https://spire.bh/#events): upcoming workshops, founder talks, and networking events
